what: 001's modelled M10 thread with ISO 4753's chamfered end at both free ends: a 45 deg cone down to the external minor diameter d3, cut after the groove
method: ISO 68-1 basic profile (60 deg, root flat P/4 at d - 5H/4 ... minor d1 = d - 1.0825 P, crest flat P/8): a helical groove of fixed section is a screw motion, so averaged over the turn every meridian half-plane holds the same section and V = 2 pi int int r m(r) dr dz over the stock's section, m the material fraction per pitch; the groove runs out past free ends. Tolerance 0.01%: SMLib's exact screw sweep; the chamfer is axisymmetric and cut after the groove, so it only lowers the stock's outer radius: r <= d_f/2 + distance from the end (45 deg), d_f the external minor diameter d3 = d - 1.226869 P = 8.160 (ISO 724; ISO 4753 chamfered end: the end's diameter at most the minor diameter), below the modelled root d1
